plan.title: Material PR RFQ Conversion to Auction and PO

args.title: Material PR RFQ Auction PO Test

steps.note: Give the event a searchable title required for publishing and later History verification.
Commit the 30-minute bidding schedule.
Invite two QA vendors to represent Vendor A and Vendor B without inventing company names.
Publish the RFQ so both vendors can quote.
Confirm the RFQ reached a published project page.
Submit the first vendor's RFQ quote of 100.
Verify the first RFQ quote was accepted.
Submit the second vendor's RFQ quote of 90.
Verify the second RFQ quote was accepted.
Wait for the RFQ bidding window to close before conversion.
Convert the published RFQ to an auction while retaining its participants and RFQ quotes.
Publish the converted auction.
Confirm the converted auction is published and ready for auction bids.
Submit Vendor A's auction bid of 85.
Verify Vendor A's auction bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's auction bid of 88.
Verify Vendor B's auction bid was accepted.
Wait for the auction to close before ranking and award actions.
Open the comparison grid for the closed auction.
Verify that both real vendor columns appear in Master QCS.
Verify that the lower auction amount is ranked first, establishing Vendor A's rank 1 outcome.
Open the awarding flow after the auction has closed.
Allocate the whole line to the lowest bidder as the closest supported award operation; exact split quantities are not expressible.
Verify that one line item has been allocated to one vendor in the supported whole-line award flow.
Submit the closest supported award proposal to the lowest bidder.
Confirm that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted proposal with the required remark.
Complete the approved award flow and create the purchase order.
Verify that a PO was created carrying the awarded PR line.
Return to the events list to verify the event's final lifecycle placement.
Open the History tab where the closed and awarded event should appear.
Verify that this plan's event appears in History.
